title: Beautiful!
text: Beautiful!. This is a beautiful serving board/cutting board. The artwork is really nice. I am hesitant to use it as a cutting board for fear of damaging it. Right now I am hanging it up in my kitchen. This would make a lovely gift!

product_metadata.title: Totally Bamboo California State Shaped Cutting Board and Charcuterie Serving Platter with Artwork by Fish Kiss, Includes Hang Tie for Wall Display
features: Celebrate Life in The Golden State: features a beautifully illustrated map by Fish Kiss, see if you can find your home town
A Fun Charcuterie Board: serve on the brightly-colored board and talk with friends and family about memories of your favorite places
Wonderful for Wall Art: the included hang tie allows the board to easily double as decor in your kitchen, dining room or den; board measures 14-1/4" x 11" x 5/8"
All the Benefits of Bamboo: flip the board over to its blank back side to use as a knife-friendly bamboo cutting board for food prep
Great for Gifting: a perfect gift for anyone on your list that loves California; give as a present for birthdays, housewarming, Christmas, Mother's Day and more
